evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Define, implement, and uphold data governance and quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of data across all analytics initiatives
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD is dominated by governance, data quality, testing, and standards language throughout the duties and requirements, with no velocity-oriented phrasing anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed data stewardship practices and maintain trust in enterprise data assets
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is enterprise retail reporting affecting business decisions (merchandising, supply chain, finance) without explicit regulatory/financial-reporting language, so moderate rather than high.
evidence.collaboration_width: Merchandising; Planning & Allocation; Supply Chain; Finance; Marketing
evidence.data_team_maturity: Developing and automating enterprise-level and executive-facing analytical solutions using BI tools including SAP BW HANA, QlikView/Qlik Sense, and SAP Business Objects
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role manages an existing team of analysts and consultants, administers a mature BI platform (Power BI, Snowflake, SAP BW), and oversees vendors — a hallmark of an established, specialized function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Maintaining and enhancing BI data models and metrics in Snowflake using SQL and DAX query language, including model management, to support enterprise reporting
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The requirements section names precise tools, methodologies, and year-by-year technical experience thresholds, giving a clear picture of the actual day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Act as a bridge between technical teams and business leaders (Merchandising, Planning & Allocation, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, etc.)
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Multiple distinct stakeholder groups (commercial merchandising, finance, supply chain) are given genuinely equal weight as partners, with no single function dominating.
evidence.autonomy_level: Develop and drive the enterprise-wide analytics strategy across Madewell, J.Crew, and J.Crew Factory, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and brand needs
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role sets analytics strategy, leads a team, and owns the full analytics lifecycle rather than executing scoped work for others.
evidence.ai_role: Architecting and implementing AI/LLM-powered agentic analytics solutions that enhance enterprise decision-making and operational efficiency
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build AI/LLM-powered analytics infrastructure and data pipelines (dbt with automated testing) that AI systems run on, making this an ai_enabler role.
evidence.testing_framing: Designing and orchestrating scalable data transformation workflows using dbt, incorporating automated testing, version control with GitHub, and documentation best practices to deliver analytics-ready data models
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is explicitly named as something the candidate designs and owns as part of building data transformation workflows, not just a listed skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Define, implement, and uphold data governance and quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of data across all analytics initiatives
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Governance and data quality are recurring themes throughout, but the JD is framed primarily around delivery and strategy rather than compliance or regulatory risk, keeping it at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Manage data standardization, ETL, and data modeling processes so that reports and dashboards are accurate and consistent
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role manages and scales an existing multi-brand BI platform and team rather than building new infrastructure from zero.
evidence.work_arrangement: LOCATION: New York, NY (A hybrid work schedule may be permitted within a commutable distance from the worksite, in accordance with company policies.)
